title: From field-scale to large-scale spectral libraries: Tabular foundation models in soil spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2608.00608v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) and mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy enable rapid, cost-effective prediction of soil properties. Yet, translating high-dimensional, highly collinear spectra into accurate soil property predictions remains challenging, particularly when employing machine learning. We systematically investigated regression models and dimensionality reduction approaches for spectroscopic modeling across 85 soil property prediction tasks from open benchmark datasets in pedometrics, spanning field-scale digital soil mapping and a global soil spectral library. We compared an in-context learning tabular foundation model (TabPFN), a convolutional neural network (CNN), rule-based regression (Cubist), Random Forest, and partial least squares regression (PLSR) using full spectra as well as features derived from principal component analysis (PCA) and partial least squares (PLS) latent variables. translated_title: 从田间尺度到大规模光谱库：表格基础模型在土壤光谱学中的应用
translated_abstract: 可见光-近红外（vis-NIR）和中红外（MIR）光谱技术能够实现土壤特性的快速、低成本预测。然而，如何将高维、高度共线的光谱转化为准确的土壤特性预测仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在应用机器学习方法时。我们系统地研究了用于光谱建模的回归模型和降维方法，涵盖了来自土壤计量学开放基准数据集的85个土壤特性预测任务，涉及田间尺度的数字土壤制图和全球土壤光谱库。我们比较了基于上下文学习的表格基础模型（TabPFN）、卷积神经网络（CNN）、基于规则的回归（Cubist）、随机森林和偏最小二乘回归（PLSR），这些方法分别使用全光谱以及由主成分分析（PCA）和偏最小二乘（PLS）潜在变量导出的特征。TabPFN始终表现出……
tldr: 该研究系统评估了TabPFN表格基础模型在85个土壤光谱特性预测任务中的表现，发现其始终优于CNN、Cubist、随机森林和PLSR等传统方法，为从田间尺度到全球尺度的土壤光谱建模提供了更优的新方案。
en_tdlr: This study systematically benchmarked the TabPFN tabular foundation model against CNN, Cubist, Random Forest, and PLSR across 85 soil property prediction tasks, showing that TabPFN consistently delivered superior performance in soil spectroscopy from field-scale to global-scale applications.
